title: Delicious Weeknight Pregnancy Menus: 5 Cook-Once Recipes
excerpt: Five flavorful recipes for busy evenings — soup, stir-fry, egg dishes and yogurt parfaits — balanced for protein, fiber and calcium.
content:
## Introduction
When pregnant, eating a healthy and balanced diet is crucial to ensure the health of both mother and baby. However, with a busy lifestyle, preparing meals every day can be a challenge. In this article, we will introduce 5 cook-once recipes for delicious and nutritious weeknight meals, suitable for pregnant women.

## Nutrient Analysis
The recipes below are designed to provide a balanced amount of protein, fiber, and calcium, essential nutrients for fetal development and maternal health.

* Chicken soup with vegetables: provides protein from chicken, fiber from vegetables, and calcium from chicken bones.
* Beef stir-fry with broccoli: provides protein from beef, fiber from broccoli, and calcium from beef.
* Poached eggs with salad: provides protein from eggs, fiber from salad, and calcium from eggs.
* Yogurt parfait with granola and fruit: provides calcium from yogurt, fiber from granola and fruit.
* Fried rice with eggs and vegetables: provides protein from eggs, fiber from vegetables, and calcium from eggs.

## Recipes
Here are 5 cook-once recipes for delicious and nutritious weeknight meals:

1. Chicken soup with vegetables: Cook 1 chicken with 2 carrots, 2 potatoes, and 1 bunch of broccoli. Add 1 tablespoon of salt and 1 tablespoon of sugar. Cook for 30 minutes.
2. Beef stir-fry with broccoli: Stir-fry 100g of beef with 1 bunch of broccoli, 1 onion, and 2 cloves of garlic. Add 1 tablespoon of oil and 1 tablespoon of soy sauce. Cook for 10 minutes.
3. Poached eggs with salad: Poach 2 eggs with 1 bunch of lettuce, 1 carrot, and 1/2 onion. Add 1 tablespoon of oil and 1 tablespoon of vinegar.
4. Yogurt parfait with granola and fruit: Mix 1 cup of yogurt with 2 tablespoons of granola and 1 fruit. Add 1 tablespoon of honey.
5. Fried rice with eggs and vegetables: Fry 1 cup of rice with 1 egg, 1 bunch of broccoli, and 1 carrot. Add 1 tablespoon of oil and 1 tablespoon of soy sauce.

## Practical Tips
To ensure food safety, remember:
* Cook meat and eggs before eating.
* Wash vegetables before eating.
* Avoid eating undercooked or expired food.
* Check out our [meal planner](/planner) for more ideas on healthy meals.

## When to Seek Help
If you have any questions or concerns about your diet, consult your doctor or a nutritionist. They can help you create a personalized meal plan.
